# Burning Springs: Maintenance Gift and more from Bethesda

![Burning Springs: Maintenance Gift and more from Bethesda](/uploads/602_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The maintenance for Burning Springs took significantly longer than normal for a content update. There are still various other problems with the quests and challenges. As a small thank you for our patience and compensation, Bethesda is now giving us a few small gifts.

Bethesda writes:

Hey Vault Dwellers, We would like to thank you for your patience and understanding as we work through the login issues that many were facing when the Burning Springs Update launched. To support your adventures in Burning Springs and your new career as a bounty hunter, we have put together a great package for you. **Seven days of additional daily challenges and one additional weekly**From December 5th at 6 p.m “Go up a level.” The points received for this are doubled. We're also adding an additional weekly challenge that will launch alongside the reset on December 9th.**Free SCORE Booster**Today at 6pm CET, a free SCORE Booster will be unlocked for all users on the Atomic Shop account page. This one-time booster can be redeemed through Tuesday, December 9th.**Bonus Caps Launches Today!**To help you on your bounty hunting adventures, we're launching Bottle Cap Fun early (starting at 12pm EST)! Get ready to sell your favorite items at your favorite merchant, collect bottle caps, and score bounties from the Ghoul. Bottle Caps Plenty ends on December 15th as previously announced.

**Gifts on a Line**Spend the holidays with a weekend of fishing! Every weekend in the run-up to Christmas you have the chance to catch some great prey. Discover new fishing spots in Burning Springs, cast your lines and tell us about your catch!

Additionally, we would like to provide you with an update on some topics that have been widely discussed since launch.**Craft decorative furnishings in workshops and reset the 7600 CAMP challenge.**We have received reports that this challenge has been reset. Unfortunately, the previous completion status cannot be restored. To make completing this challenge worthwhile again, we will be making the following adjustments:

- Added player titles (suffixes) to the three building challenges

- “Producing decorative furnishings in workshops and camps” – designer title
- “Construct Buildings in Workshops and CAMPs” – Architect Tile (Granted automatically to everyone who has already completed this)
- “Create functional objects in workshops and CAMPs” = Engineer title (Awarded automatically to those who have already completed the task)
- The Atom reward for the “Build Decorative Furnishings in Workshops and CAMPs” challenge will be increased from 80 Atoms to 160 Atoms.
*The above player titles and Atom reward increase will be available after the game's next major update, currently scheduled for January 2026.*Free Vault-Tec Supply Packs will be available in the Atomic Shop daily starting December 9th through December 30th. So be sure to grab these extra supplies to support your CAMP building projects.**Items missing from camp**The team is aware of the issue and is investigating it.
